edmontosaurus: MINIMAL LOCAL EYE VISIBILITY EDIT of this already registered native pixelart reference. Species:edmontosaurus,a herbivorous ornithopod with eyes on the LATERAL SIDES of its skull,not crocodile eyes on the dorsal top. Return the same transparent1536x1024 2x2 layout:top-leftS,top-rightE,bottom-leftN,bottom-rightW. Preserve EXACT body/limb/tail outlines,markings,palette,camera,size,rootpositions and3x native pixel clusters;no repainting,enhancement,zoom,added detail or redesign. Modify ONLY tiny eye-area pixels on the head. Treat the camera as a fixed high-overhead view slightly from screen-bottom,matching the in-game reference. In EAST andWEST,only the LOWER/near-side lateral eye may show a tiny slit/glint at the HEAD EDGE;the far UPPER eye is hidden by cranium,so replace any upper dorsal eye-dot with normal skull skintexture. In NORTH,both lateral pupils are hidden behind skull/brow ridges:remove visible dark paired pupils from top of skull,keep natural brow/side contour. In SOUTH,the high overhead camera permits only very subtle lateral EDGE glints/partly occluded eye slits,not a pair of large fully exposed black eyes atop head. Never move an eye into the top center of skull or put an eye on neck,shell,bill or hand. All other pixels and features must remain as reference. Eye visibility follows orbit position and occlusion,not a requirement to show both eyes in every view. No aura,shadow,text,labels or extra body parts.
